messages:
maria-g: Heads-up — saw quota enforcement lagging after a config push. Some requests routing to old cohort for ~20s after rollout. Anyone else? @ops-bot FYI

jason-b: seeing it in traces — route-change events show up late. latency spikes correlate with config-propagation TTL in config-service. :eyes:

sanjay: which config push? key name?

maria-g: /configs/runtime/route_shard_v2 bump from 0 -> 1 at 5087654321. console shows 100% applied, but nodes report old shard until ~5087654341

kevin: can you paste the log from gateway?

maria-g: logs:
```
[5087654321] config_applied: true -> broadcast_start pid=2145
[5087654328] route_table_reload: ok
[5087654342] cohort_assignments: updated to v2
```

elaine: looks like there's a window where console marks success before all routing agents ack. We intentionally moved to async propagation to reduce deploy tail latency.

jason-b: current RPC to agents uses fire-and-forget; we don't await agent ack. That optimizes but causes temporary split-brain for 10-30s.

maria-g: agree. This caused quota counters to be counted against wrong shard (shard v1 counters not carrying over), so some customers saw rate-limited 429s.

sanjay: proposal: add a 'soft-steady' check — console waits for N of M agents to ack OR until timeout. Show 'propagating' state in UI rather than 'applied'

kevin: also maybe emit telemetry events: config_propagation_start, agent_ack(list), propagation_latency distribution. We have partial telemetry but not per-config.

elaine: +1. Also we should patch routing to honor new config only if KV cache refreshed — simple guard: don't use new variant until local coherent snapshot. That avoids counts split.

jason-b: tradeoff: add latency. How about progressive activation: route new traffic to v2 only after cohort thresholds reached. That is more complex.

maria-g: short term: change console UI label + increment telemetry. Long term: consider quorum-ack and progressive activation. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-221 — config propagation lag. @oncall please review runbook.

kevin: I'll open a PR for telemetry + UI flag. @sanjay can you draft config-service change for quorum? tagging for review.
